title: Find the Maximum Sum of Node Values
summary: Given an undirected tree with n nodes numbered 0 to n-1, and an array nums of node values, Alice can perform an operation any number of times to maximize the sum of node values.
statement: Given an undirected tree with n nodes numbered 0 to n-1, and an array nums of node values, Alice can perform an operation any number of times to maximize the sum of node values. The operation involves choosing an edge between nodes u and v and updating their values using XOR with k. Return the maximum possible sum of node values after any number of operations.
constraints: nums describes a connected tree with n nodes and n-1 edges.
An operation chooses an edge and XORs both endpoint values with k.
Return the maximum achievable sum after any number of operations.
hints: Every edge operation toggles two nodes, so the number of toggled nodes is even.
In a connected tree, every even-size node subset can be produced by edge operations.
Scan values while tracking best sums for an even or odd number of chosen XOR values.
The two-state transition considers keeping or XORing each node; only the final even state is feasible.
editorial: The two-state transition considers keeping or XORing each node; only the final even state is feasible.

tests.explanation: Toggle edge 0-2 to obtain values 2,2,2 and total six.
Either toggle both endpoints or neither; the unchanged sum five is larger.
